Order pizza by voice agent from ChatGPT or Claude
An MCP lets a user describe a pizza order in ChatGPT or Claude, review and confirm it, then a voice agent calls the restaurant to place it.
·
Oct 1, 2026
Done with
GP
ChatGPT
CL
Claude
What they did
Ale says he built PizzaBot as an MCP for ChatGPT and Claude. A user describes a pizza order in chat, reviews and confirms it, then the tool’s voice agent calls the restaurant; the result is returned in chat, and he says it also handles delivery, pickup, and table bookings.
How it went
He says he tested it and opened it internationally. The post gives no metrics, examples of completed orders, or detail on failures.
Worth knowing
The main catch is that the source is very thin: it describes the flow at a high level but gives no costs, timing, or technical setup details.
Try it yourself
with
ChatGPT
Copy prompt
I want to order a [size and toppings] pizza for [pickup or delivery] from [restaurant name and city or phone number]. Put the order together with any substitutions or notes: [notes]. Show me the full order, the restaurant, and the pickup name and time, then wait for my explicit confirmation before placing the call or ordering anything.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/GPT/comments/1x2o39n/i_built_an_mcp_to_order_pizza_from_chatgpt_and
